[[File:Clone_cadet.svg|thumb|right|200px|The clone army project emblem]]
The '''clone army project emblem''' was the emblem of the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] project of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] used by the [[Ruling Council (Kamino)/Legends|Kaminoan government]] and the [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AotC:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The clone cadets, who were training to become [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]s of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] utilized the insignia on their uniforms.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>
